judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: Short, slightly stiff guard barks ('It's meant for your own good', 'Move on!', 'You may pass, Adventurer') match Nox's gate-guard formula and its capitalised form of address. 'The wilds hold far too many perils for the common man' is a touch ornate, but it is in period.
